title: As-Sami' - The All-Hearing

captions.tiktok: A woman whispered her heartbreak to Allah, and He answered her from above the seven heavens. Allah is as-Sami', the All-Hearing. Qur'an 58:1.
captions.shorts: Allah heard the whispered plea no one else could - the story behind Surah al-Mujadila 58:1. He is as-Sami', the All-Hearing.
captions.reels: Whatever you can only whisper, Allah has already heard. As-Sami', the All-Hearing. Qur'an 58:1.

segments.text: A woman whispered her heartbreak, too quiet for anyone to hear. But Allah heard every word.
In Madinah, a woman named Khaulah came to the Prophet, peace be upon him. Her husband had wronged her.
She pleaded again and again, but no answer came. So she turned to Allah alone.
She thought no one was listening. But her every word had already reached her Lord.
Allah has heard the words of the woman pleading about her husband, and complaining to Him. And Allah hears your conversation. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
segments.arabicText: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

segments.text: Aisha, the Prophet's wife, would say, blessed is the One whose hearing encompasses every voice.
Whatever you only whisper, Allah has already heard. He is as-Sami, the All-Hearing.
